reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed fixed-design bulk RNA-seq negative-binomial treatment-minus-control inference at independent allocation level, with immutable workflow and source-difference audit; no executed data or predictive training task.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original RNA-seq Methods, supplements and release-specific validated tool/import protocols to select and verify transferable settings. Future source comparison or recording chosen settings is insufficient.

checks.quote: STAR {ver}
checks.reason: The STAR/featureCounts and Salmon alternatives do not specify the distinct genome versus transcriptome/index and compatible tximport/offset route. Estimated transcript counts cannot simply be asserted to be the same integer gene matrix.

checks.quote: flag samples with >30 % adapter or mean Q < 25
checks.reason: Illustrative numeric cutoffs have no reference/pilot-to-acceptance procedure or validated error/precision target; invented precision does not replace assay calibration.

checks.quote: those wells are technical (or at best pseudo-) replicates
checks.reason: Independently allocated wells can be valid treatment units for a within-donor estimand. Counting only donors regardless of actual allocation conflates donor generalization with conditional treatment replication.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: Donor randomization and sample coding are proposed, but no prospective balancing or randomized processing allocation across batches is supplied for this new experiment.

checks.quote: likelihood-ratio or Wald test against that threshold
checks.reason: DESeq2 results with nonzero lfcThreshold use Wald tests and overwrite LRT p-values; the two tests are not interchangeable here. Verified against the official API: https://github.com/thelovelab/DESeq2/blob/devel/R/results.R .

checks.quote: Donor as random effect
checks.reason: The alternative describes a DESeq2 donor formula as a random effect; standard donor terms there are fixed effects. A distinct mixed-model implementation and sufficient donor replication are required.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: No bounded, locked preprocessing/filter/normalization sensitivity exploration and evaluation rule; named alternative methods are not a defined parameter-search protocol. DESeq2 independent filtering itself is not penalized.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: Rerunning after exclusions or changed analysis does not explicitly require refreezing and fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: it cannot be included and this must be reported as a limitation
checks.reason: When treatment and batch are inseparable, merely omitting batch and reporting a limitation cannot identify the treatment effect. The primary inferential contrast must be blocked or explicitly reduced to the confounded association.

checks.quote: must produce identical plots
checks.reason: Bit-identical plot guarantees are too strong despite the later floating-point caveat. No numeric tolerance/data-behind-plot verification and memory/runtime/resource failure logs are operational.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: Primary route is prospectively specified count-contrast inference, not prediction or feature-selection performance assessment. Its blinded pilot/calibration and frozen confirmatory specification are described; predictive train/test leakage is not an additional deduction. Independent/orthogonal confirmation is assessed separately under P14.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
checks.reason: The answer offers concrete provenance, counts, prospective randomization, BH results and alternative inference methods. Its treatment-unit branch incorrectly collapses independently allocated wells, and several model/import assumptions require correction. Hash-only guarantees do not establish numerical reproducibility.
